# Security reports for Day 04

Report a suspected vulnerability privately to the repository owner through the contact link in the app's Help section. Send the affected URL or offline release version, the affected feature and a minimal reproduction using fictional data. Avoid posting private worksheet answers or an exploit against another user's data in a public issue.

Dependencies are pinned by package-lock.json. Run npm audit and rebuild the offline downloads when upgrading a bundled library. Changes to imports, rendering, sharing or exports require adversarial input and data-exclusion checks. Generated software notices and the dependency inventory accompany each release.
